variants.headline: Looking back: home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had changed the colony's charter.

The charter has changed. It may sound like a subject for a very long document, and it is still a subject for the people who live under it. Ask about authority. Ask about fairness. Do not accept a made-up list of new powers just because the word 'charter' sounds impressive.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We support {target} in this assessment. A charter change deserves judgment on its merits, rather than condemnation merely because the framework has been altered by an authority exercising its claimed role.

variants.headline: Looking back: colonial charter amended
variants.sub: The colony's charter has been altered by the home world.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: An amendment to the colony's charter had been made by the home world.

The charter has changed. It may sound like a subject for a very long document, and it is still a subject for the people who live under it. Ask about authority. Ask about fairness. Do not accept a made-up list of new powers just because the word 'charter' sounds impressive.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

We support {target} in this assessment. A charter change deserves judgment on its merits, rather than condemnation merely because the framework has been altered by an authority exercising its claimed role.

variants.headline: Looking back: the terms of authority are altered
variants.sub: The home world has changed the colony's charter.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The colony's charter had been altered by the home world.

The charter has changed. It may sound like a subject for a very long document, and it is still a subject for the people who live under it. Ask about authority. Ask about fairness. Do not accept a made-up list of new powers just because the word 'charter' sounds impressive.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

We support {target} in this assessment. A charter change deserves judgment on its merits, rather than condemnation merely because the framework has been altered by an authority exercising its claimed role.
